item.text: For the selected 316L, the tool gives a solid Young’s modulus of 193 GPa. The solid-fraction upper bound at 16% is \(0.16 \times 193 = 30.88\) GPa, below the required 38.6 GPa. This rules out the specification regardless of unit-cell geometry.

arguments.note: User selected 316L (E_s=193 GPa, nu=0.3). For a void/316L lattice in linear elasticity, the Voigt energy bound C_eff <= phi C_s implies each directional Young's modulus E_i <= phi E_s. With phi<=0.16, E_i<=30.88 GPa, below the required 38.6 GPa (=0.20 E_s). Thus no periodic geometry can meet the stated requirements for this material. No design released.
